text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
So this is a Japanese racecourse...
Not bad
at all.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
Far-east nation of Japan... Do you truly
harbor the opponent I seek?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
...Had my timing been even slightly
off, it
would have been you who
crossed the
finish line first.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
This truly was a narrow victory...
I've never
had a race that left my
heart pounding like
this before.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
Only the strong could do this to me. El
Condor Pasa, you are truly
worthy of the
title champion.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, coming to Japan will make
your heart pound even
harder.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: Japan?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I didn't get this strong on my own. It was
thanks to my friends—my
rivals in
Japan—that I got to this point.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If I'm worthy of the champion title, that
means we've got lots more
champions in
Japan!

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
I can still vividly recall how my heart
soared hearing those words.
Even now,
they make every cell in my body quake in
anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
...Be sure to entertain me, Umamusume of
Japan.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
At last,
the day we've all been waiting for!
Acclaimed Umamusume
the world over
have gathered here for the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And we have quite the lineup this year!
We have a total of four Derby

Umamusume, including the winner of the
Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But the name on everyone's lips is the
winner of the Prix de l'Arc de

Triomphe—the one who defeated El
Condor Pasa—Montjeu!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Just how will the racers of Japan face
her?!
And who among these
racers will be
declared the world's strongest?!

text_block_list.name: Optimistic Fan
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe Grass Wonder had to pull
out...

text_block_list.name: Skeptical Fan
text_block_list.text:
With Grass Wonder, I was sure Japan had
a chance, but I'm not so
sure now.

text_block_list.name: Skeptical Fan
text_block_list.text:
These overseas racers are on a whole
nother level... And that's not
even
considering Montjeu.

text_block_list.name: Optimistic Fan
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I bet you're still rooting for
Japan, right?

text_block_list.name: Skeptical Fan
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am, but I also want to be
realistic...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Inhale... exhale...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I see you're a little nervous after all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, more like super nervous...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of the Japanese racers, you're the one
people have the highest
expectations for
right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Conversely, you could say you show the
most potential of all the
Japanese racers.
You should be proud.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's right, you did everything you could
to prepare! You even got
down to your
ideal weight! Way to go, Spe!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wh-why do you know about my weight?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And what's more, you'll have a reassuring
ally watching over you soon
enough.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Who could that—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Perfect timing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Good... Looks like I made it in time.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh... Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka's here?! Wait, why
would—America! You were in America!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I wouldn't dare watch such an
important race on TV.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Woooow! It's Suzuka! She's here! She's
really here!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since Team Sirius was
all
together, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Well,
this is a big race! We need the whole
team here!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Our cheers will be the loudest in the
stands!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe, I've heard a lot about today's racers
while overseas.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I want you to show them all
how much you shine. I
believe that is our
greatest wish as your teammates.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My teammates' wish...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You better give us a dream performance
today.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You better give us a dream performance
today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Sei! Everybody!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We're here to cheer you on, Special Week.
I'm happy to see you look
calm and
collected.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well yeah, she's not you, you know.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pardon?! Are you implying I get nervous?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, thanks for coming, King, Sei.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
They always call Japanese racers weak,
but don't let them get in your
head. If you
run like you always do, I'm sure you'll do
fine.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky is injured...
and I've decided to
take a different path, so we
won't be
running today.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You know what that means, Spe. You
gotta work hard for all of us!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and
finally the Kikuka Sho...
Run like you did
against us in the Classics!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
I'll run fast enough for both of you.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Spe, I've always admired you, and I think
that's what helped me run
with the energy
I have now!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So you better show 'em all! Show 'em the
run I saw at the autumn
Tenno Sho—the
one you can't help but try to chase!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Your running form is also forever carved
into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
At the spring Tenno Sho... your
performance left me wanting more... I

wanted to follow after you—to someday
surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Therefore,
I hope you will allow me to race
you again. I would like
very much to win
against a world champion.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Don't worry, Tsuru,
Bright! I'll give a
race performance that'll
get your
competitive fire burning!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like you're more than ready for
this, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my faith in you feels much more
secure than usual.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El! Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I would prefer to pay back
Montjeu myself, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You'll have to do it for me,
Spe! Don't you
dare lose!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I believe in you, Spe. I know you can win.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And once you do,
I'll be waiting for you...
at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I swear I'll win!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
At last, the racers for today's Japan Cup
are stepping onto the turf.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The most popular of the Japanese racers is
Special Week! Just look at
how the Ruler
of Japan shines!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You've got this, Speee!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Speee! Fight oooon!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Something wrong, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, I simply was reminded of something
when I saw Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I swear that when we watched Rice, Ticket,
Brian, and even Suzuka head for their
races,
they shined just as gallantly as she
does now.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Watching you was the same way, you
know. You were practically
glowing with
the desire to fulfill your dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fulfill my dream... Nothing ever changes,
does it? You're always
thinking of us, and
we never want to disappoint you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The members of Team Sirius all ran to
achieve their dreams... Let's see
you do the
same, Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: We finally meet, Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, it's nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa... Your friend gave me a
race that I could never
forget.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
Running against her brought just as much
joy as winning the Arc. It
truly changed my
perception of Japan's racers.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
I want to feel that joy—that rush—once
again. That desire is what
brought me here
today.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I hope your performance today
will grant that wish...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I never thought you'd have such high
hopes for me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me. I'll grant your wish by
becoming the best racer in
Japan, here
and now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: May the best racer win, Montjeu!

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: <May the best racer win, Special Week.>
